_comment: Copy to bello.local.json, add your free keys, then: scripts/push-config.sh. Model names go stale — check with scripts/models.sh gemini|groq.

_keys.cloudflare: https://dash.cloudflare.com (AI → Workers AI → Use REST API)

_tvBox: The SFR TV decoder (docs/sfr-tv-box.md). On by default at the box name "stb"; "channels" replaces the whole table; "enabled": false turns it off.
_images: The picture on the details page (docs/page-images.md), tried in this order. Cloudflare: a free account, no card — dash.cloudflare.com → AI → Workers AI → Use REST API gives the token (Workers AI permission) and the account id. Pollinations: a free key at enter.pollinations.ai; without a key it still answers, with a weak model and its logo. Try a prompt from the Mac: scripts/image.sh.
_fuel: The fuel the house buys: gazole, sp95, sp98, e10, e85 or gplc. Also holidayZone, schoolZone, schoolAcademy.
